title: SOC automation
description: Operate defensive SOC automation as an auditable workflow: case management, orchestration, bounded enrichment, approval gates, metrics, and offline playbook testing.

lessons.title: SOAR concepts
lessons.summary: Learn how a SOC workflow turns inputs into observable, reviewable decisions.
objectives: Identify triggers, steps and results
Distinguish orchestration from automated action
Explain ownership, idempotence and safe failure

lessons.title: TheHive and Cortex
lessons.summary: Relate alerts, cases and observables in TheHive to Cortex analysis and response responsibilities.
objectives: Distinguish an alert, case, task and observable
Interpret contextual analysis reports
Explain responder approval and result verification

lessons.title: Shuffle workflows
lessons.summary: Design and review a Shuffle workflow using synthetic inputs and non-operational destinations.
objectives: Trace trigger data through actions and branches
Explain execution evidence and confidential fields
Test valid inputs, retries and skipped actions

lessons.title: Approval gates
lessons.summary: Design a human gate that approves a specific defensive action with scoped authority.
objectives: Capture a complete approval request
Handle denials, expiration and changed scope
Verify approval and outcome independently

lessons.title: Enrichment automation
lessons.summary: Build an enrichment workflow that records provenance, freshness and uncertainty.
objectives: Normalize a typed observable without losing the original
Apply approved data handling and cache boundaries
Distinguish no-match, stale, error and unknown

lessons.title: Metrics
lessons.summary: Measure workflow performance and outcomes without mistaking automation volume for effectiveness.
objectives: Define comparable metric endpoints and denominators
Interpret queue, approval and verification metrics
Identify quality tradeoffs from cohort comparisons

lessons.title: Safe playbooks
lessons.summary: Design playbooks with bounded authority, safe failure, duplicate handling and an audit trail.
objectives: Specify preconditions and safe failure states
Prevent duplicate side effects and stale approvals
Reconcile partial actions and plan recovery

lessons.title: Automation lab
lessons.summary: Test an offline automation playbook using a fictional case and check its outcome record.
objectives: Run a local fixture through the simulated workflow
Exercise duplicates, bad data and awaiting approval
Produce an audit and human handoff
